Return a regular error instead of crashing when required block or undo data is missing
agreement: Concept approval for a contained fix preventing daemon assertion failures (musaHaruna)
Open suggestion to adjust boundary checks and cover non-pruned snapshot nodes (musaHaruna)

why: P2 because node crashes from assertion failures represent a severe reliability issue
Impact is confined to pruned assumeutxo nodes attempting rollbacks without required historical data
